written.headline: Researchers publish paper and dataset mapping the AI supply chain
written.summary: Researchers published a paper and dataset that maps actors and relationships in the organizational AI supply chain. The work examines industry concentration, dependencies, chokepoints, and market flows across models, data, chips, infrastructure, capital, and talent.

written.headline: Meta staff raised alarms over Muse AI privacy issues and data leaks
written.summary: Internal chats revealed Meta employees raised alarms that the Muse AI agent accessed encrypted messages, mixed up user conversations, and exposed sensitive financial data. The app reached over 10 million downloads in two months before the privacy concerns surfaced.

written.headline: Intel signs first outside customer for 18A chips
written.summary: Intel signed its first outside customer for its 18A chips in a milestone for its foundry business. The external customer committed to Intel's 18A-P manufacturing process node.

written.headline: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains 60,000 employee buyouts and AI shift
written.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained that offering voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees is part of reorganizing the company into an AI-first business where workers manage AI agents. Nadella also unveiled new enterprise AI models and infrastructure at the Ignite 2026 event.

written.headline: UK does not need its own frontier AI model, says AI minister
written.summary: Britain does not need to develop its own frontier AI model and should instead rely on access to technology from trusted allies, according to AI minister Kanishka Narayan. The minister said public funds will instead prioritize areas like chip design and compound semiconductors where the UK can build a competitive advantage.

written.headline: Mistral AI not French president's personal project, says CEO
written.summary: Mistral AI CEO Arthur Mensch rejected claims that the $24 billion startup is a personal project of French President Emmanuel Macron. Mensch stated that support for artificial intelligence transcends political boundaries and that the firm is preparing for an initial public offering in Europe.
